mainEntity.name: What is an AI Voice Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI Voice Agent is an intelligent virtual agent that can handle phone calls autonomously using natural language processing. Unlike traditional IVR systems, it understands free-form speech, maintains context across conversations, and can take actions like updating CRM records or booking meetings.

mainEntity.name: How fast does the RoboRingo AI agent respond?

acceptedAnswer.text: RoboRingo AI agents respond in under 500 milliseconds, creating a natural conversational experience that feels like talking to a real person.

mainEntity.name: Can the AI agent handle multiple languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, RoboRingo AI agents support 50+ languages with automatic language detection. They can switch languages mid-conversation based on the caller's preference.
